name: Huggies free newborn diapers and wipes sign-up
whatYouGet: Huggies' US sign-up page says signing up gets free newborn diapers and wipes for babies up to 4 weeks old. Older babies get coupons instead.
costDetail: Free to sign up; the page shows no fee, but US terms were not visible in search results
eligibility: Baby up to 4 weeks old (the page's wording); babies over 18 lb get coupons instead. US terms not confirmed.
catches: The page is framed around Safe Sleep Awareness (October), so the offer may have ended or may be seasonal. The US terms, offer dates and supply limits could not be read. Whether it can be claimed before the birth is unclear (the Canadian Hug Box allows 20 weeks pregnant, but that is a different country). Pack size is not stated.
notes: A separate No Baby Unhugged page offers a free pack of diapers and wipes for sharing a hug photo; its US terms were not confirmed either. Huggies also has an insurer-mailer sample box (10-digit code from a mailer), which most people cannot use. Check the page before relying on it.
freeStuff: A pack of newborn Huggies diapers and wipes, for babies up to 4 weeks old.
valueBasis: One small pack of newborn diapers and one wipes pack at the low end; pack size not stated
whenNote: The page says the free newborn pack is for babies up to 4 weeks old.

name: Baby's Only A2 organic formula free sample
whatYouGet: The A2 Organic Milk infant formula page says you can get a free sample and pay only shipping. Nature's One also has a free-sample-program page.
costDetail: Page says "just pay for shipping"; the shipping amount and sample size were not shown in search results
eligibility: Not stated. Limits, if any, were not visible.
catches: Search snippets of the offer text may be old (one page showed as indexed years ago). The sample size, shipping cost and whether it is still offered are unconfirmed, and checkout may add a subscription; read the cart before paying. A full can is listed at about $186, so this is a try-before-you-buy route, not free formula.
notes: A separate Baby's Only toddler page links to a USDA Organic sample offer with no terms shown. Nature's One blog says it would send a free full-size sample (blog is a lead only).

name: Baby Dove email sign-up (samples and coupons)
whatYouGet: Dove's US Baby Dove page says its email newsletter includes exclusive content, coupon offers and free samples. What a sample is, and when one is sent, is not stated.
costDetail: Free email sign-up; no fee shown
catches: The official page only says the newsletter includes samples; no guaranteed sample is described, and some pages are a year or more old. Sign-up also adds you to Unilever marketing email and optional SMS.
notes: Another Dove page about switching to Baby Dove says "free samples when you sign up to our newsletter"; its terms were not visible.
